title: Delete a booking and its shipment items atomically
description: An authenticated user can delete an existing booking from the management view and the booking no longer appears afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the bookings management view
Create a booking record from the booking workflow if one is not already available
Delete the selected booking from the bookings list
Verify the deleted booking is no longer displayed

title: View the logistics dashboard with recent bookings

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the logistics dashboard
Verify recent bookings are displayed

title: Add a tracking update and see it in history
description: An authenticated user can save a new manual tracking update for a booking and then see the new entry in tracking history.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the tracking history for an existing booking
Start a new tracking update for that booking
Fill in the required tracking details with a valid status, location, and event date and time
Save the tracking update
Verify the new tracking entry appears in the history list

title: Reject a tracking update with missing required details
description: An authenticated user cannot save a tracking update when required fields are missing, and no tracking entry is created.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the tracking save form for an existing booking
Leave one or more required tracking fields empty
Save the tracking update
Verify a tracking validation error is visible
Verify no new tracking entry is created
